name: log_summarise
description: Summarise a log given inline by grouping its lines into templates: timestamps, UUIDs, IP addresses, hex ids, quoted strings and numbers are masked, then lines are clustered by Drain-like token similarity. For each template: the count, share, first and last timestamp (ISO 8601, syslog and Apache common log formats), levels and an example; overall level counts, time range and the top templates.

year.description: Year for syslog timestamps, which carry none

catalog.source: Drain (He, Zhu, Zheng and Lyu, 'Drain: An Online Log Parsing Approach with Fixed Depth Tree', IEEE ICWS 2017): length grouping and token similarity; timestamp formats from ISO 8601, RFC 3164 syslog and the Apache Common Log Format
